items.title: AI日报
items.mainLine: 今日筛出 1 条 AI 技术信号，优先看 「Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent」。脉络集中在大模型训练/推理、Agent Skill、Auto-Research/Harness 与可复制工程实践。
actionItems: 评估是否可沉淀到团队 AI Native / Agent 自进化链路：Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
watchItems: 跟进：Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent

items.title: Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA Open Indonesia’s First University AI Center to Develop Local AI Talent
items.summary: 这篇内容聚焦「AI 工具、开发者平台和工程提效」。原文摘要显示：Komdigi, Universitas Gadjah Mada, Indosat and NVIDIA launch the UGM Indosat NVIDIA AI Technology Center, bringing world-class AI infrastructure to Indonesia’s researchers and students and developers.
items.insightText: 优先找可复用的工程范式、组织实践和系统架构细节，低相关议题可直接跳过。
